english.title: Fishing vessel owner / skipper / employer employ / engage to work a person under 16 years on board a fishing vessel
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[were the owner of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), on board which a person under 16 years of age was employed or engaged to work]_
(B)_[were the skipper of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), on board which a person under 16 years of age was employed or engaged to work]_
(C)_[employed a person under 16 years of age to work on board a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 6(1) and (4) and 29(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018.

english.notes:
(i) As per paragraph 6(2), an offence is not committed in circumstances whereby -

(a) the person is 15 years of age or older;
(b) the employment or engagement is limited to light work during school holidays;
(c) the purpose of the employment or engagement is to facilitate work experience and shadowing; and (d) the person is able to demonstrate that they have completed a course of training regarding basic survival at sea which satisfied the requirements specified in Merchant Shipping Notice 1882.

(ii) Regulation 30 provides a defence for the person charged to show that all reasonable steps had been taken by that person to ensure compliance with the provision concerned.
